failedAttemptBoundary: An earlier setup failure continued into a concurrent build, exhausting Docker disk space and mixing provider images. Failed raw logs are retained separately. Final provider compile and runtime lanes use one writer, unique logs, fixed source and selection, and terminal completion before image snapshots/scans. The final isolated Mongo compile also encountered disk-full extraction once; its canonical retry and all eight journeys passed. A bounded private cache cleanup reclaimed 4.579GB before PostgreSQL. PostgreSQL then exhausted disk on both initial extraction and canonical retry. The source repair bounds loads to two images by default with a positive override; final full-stack proofs select one image per batch and reuse one complete compile union. Only owned nrb:local tags and proven private template cache entries were cleaned, reclaiming another 3.395GB; unrelated containers and images were untouched. The canonical manifest repair then exposed a physical optional Better Auth/Vitest chain despite clean direct dependencies. Backend artifact staging now removes only metadata-declared optional canonical development/native peers; final image inspections check physical pnpm package chains in all seven backend images.
